  • 【BATTERY POWERED LIGHT RECHARGEABLE, PORTABLE AND FOLDABLE】The battery powered light has a rechargeable built-in 2000mAH battery. Battery powered lights, portable lights, and rechargeable lights! This mini light is a battery powered, compact, wireless light!
  • 【EYE-CARING 3-LEVEL ADJUSTABLE BRIGHTNESS】The battery-operated light emits flicker-free, non-glare LED light. A battery-operated, mini, and rechargeable light that's easy on your eyes! It is also a dimmable desk lamp mini lamp. Short press the switch, the mini light battery light supports 3 brightness levels. You can dim the battery-operated light when you use it in your den or dim it in your bedroom. Great portable and battery lights and den lights and rechargeable lights! Just bring your portable and battery-operated lights home!
  • 【SMALL TABLE LAMP MINI LAMP: PORTABLE, FOLDABLE, COMPACT】The small table lamp has a unique design. The foldable desk lamp is great for reading, can be used as a study light, and as a battery powered lamp! This battery-powered light provides a space-saving mini light. Such a versatile portable light battery light!
  • 【MULTIPLE LIGHTING MODES, FREELY ADJUST THE ANGLE 180°】The desk lamp has 21 lamp beads, Equipped with a 3-level brightness dimming function.Table lamp head can be rotated by 180°, and the lamp arm can be rotated by 180°, allowing you to adjust a large height and angle to obtain the best lighting, which is convenient for you.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Finally, I can work at night without lighting up the whole room.
    I’d been looking for a lamp that would light only my workspace instead of the entire room. I often work or write at night, and I didn’t want to turn on my bedside lamp because it would light up the whole room. This lamp was exactly what I was looking for. The light stays focused where I need it, whether I’m working at my desk or using a small table next to my bed. The flexible arm makes it easy to direct the light without having to move the entire lamp. I also like the touch control because it’s responsive and makes it easy to switch between the three brightness levels. feature I really appreciate is that it’s rechargeable, so I don’t have to keep it plugged in while I’m using it. Since it’s lightweight and foldable, I can easily move it from my desk to my bedside table or fold it away when I’m done. If you need a lamp that lights your workspace without brightening the whole room, I think this is a great option. It has worked very well for my needs.

      Bright, flexible, easily stored, rechargeable, & reasonably priced; recommended so far.
      Reviewed in the United States on March 12, 2026
      Color: White (1-Pack)
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Review of LED Desk Lamp for Office Home & Battery Operated Lamp Rechargeable Lamp Foldable & Portable Light, LED Desk Light Strip, 3 Brightness Dimmable Small Desk Lamp Wireless Reading Lamp (White)

      I needed a smaller, lightweight, bright and flexible LED desk light to use for reading and when taking some closer pictures with my phone. With my existing lighting, I had difficulties in getting the lighting correct and without shadows. After looking at several items on Amazon, I opted for this one. The price was better for me too. I ordered the white one but thought that I had received a pink one upon receipt since the one pictured on the box was pink. Apparently, the boxes all show pink ones, I suppose. This is made in China (pictured).

      Likes: This light is quite flexible and allows different angles. Obviously, if you extend the arm with the light out too far, this will fall forward since it disrupts the center of gravity too much. If I needed it to extend farther, it would not take something of much weight to be placed on the base to keep it from tipping over. The light is quite bright. It has 3 settings of brightness. The easy-to-work single button facilitates on level 1, then level 2, then level 3, and then back off (I tried to show the different levels of lighting in my pics). The button is very easy to operate. The light came charged enough to try. The instructions suggest going ahead and charging it, which I did. A small light near the charging port illuminates red to show it is charging and turns green when completed. The charging cable is a standard USB A to USB C. I like the fact that it is rechargeable. I found this to be a reasonable price. It has a small footprint and easily folds away for storage. It's aesthetically pleasing. There are small pads on the bottom of the base to keep it from sliding around. These would make nice and inexpensive gifts.

      Dislikes: I really don’t have any dislikes at this time.

      Neutrals: Some reviewers reported the light not lasting very long, both battery life and functionality. Time and usage will be the judge. I will try to update this review accordingly if necessary.

      Finally, I can work at night without lighting up the whole room.
      Reviewed in the United States on July 13, 2026
      Color: White (1-Pack)
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I’d been looking for a lamp that would light only my workspace instead of the entire room. I often work or write at night, and I didn’t want to turn on my bedside lamp because it would light up the whole room. This lamp was exactly what I was looking for.

      The light stays focused where I need it, whether I’m working at my desk or using a small table next to my bed. The flexible arm makes it easy to direct the light without having to move the entire lamp. I also like the touch control because it’s responsive and makes it easy to switch between the three brightness levels.

      feature I really appreciate is that it’s rechargeable, so I don’t have to keep it plugged in while I’m using it. Since it’s lightweight and foldable, I can easily move it from my desk to my bedside table or fold it away when I’m done.

      If you need a lamp that lights your workspace without brightening the whole room, I think this is a great option. It has worked very well for my needs.

You can dim the battery-operated light when you use it in your den or dim it in your bedroom. Great portable and battery lights and den lights and rechargeable lights!     • 【MULTIPLE LIGHTING MODES, FREELY ADJUST THE ANGLE 180°】The desk lamp has 21 lamp beads, Equipped with a 3-level brightness dimming function.Table lamp head can be rotated by 180°, and the lamp arm can be rotated by 180°, allowing you to adjust a large height and angle to obtain the best lighting, which is convenient for you.
    • 【SAVE SPACE, TYPE-C POWER SUPPLY AND BUTTON CONTROL】Led desk lamp can be adjusted freely in multiple angles, foldable, convenient for storage, light in body, easy to carry, used in office, library and bedroom, white simplicity.You can use the Type-C charging port to power the lamp, and through button control, you can use the button panel to control the light switch and brightness.
